reviews.hash_followup: After the initial acceptance, the author added an explicit cusp substitution-kernel proof. The reviewer inspected that addition: monic division by y²−x³ leaves A(x)+yB(x); substitution produces even and odd powers of t separately, proving the exact kernel in every characteristic. The image is a domain, so the ideal is prime and is the full vanishing ideal over k. The addition is accepted. The final file was normalized to LF mechanically.
